`MessageQueue.enqueue` (`shm_broadcast.py`) already routes CPU tensors out-of-band via

title: support aiter backend for mimo models
body:
## Motivation

[Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Flash](https://huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2-Flash) is a hybrid MoE reasoning model with an unusual attention geometry: the Q/K head dimension is 192 while the V head dimension is 128 (\`qk_head_dim != v_head_dim\`). All 48 layers also use a 128-token sliding-window attention (SWA).

body:
Mentioned by @WoosukKwon in https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/23233.

The work to update logits processor states and construct the sampling metadata be deferred in model runner `execute_model` to overlap CPU with forward pass.

This has an advantage of taking the logits processor `update_states` calls off the critical path, and means we can trade off a bit of efficiency for simplicity in the API design.

There should be some incremental benefit as we migrate hard-wired sampling parameters into logits processors since their state updates are still happening in `_update_states()` before the forward pass.

title: Fix MNNVL Lamport mailbox publication and cleanup
body:
## Purpose

Fix silent output corruption in vLLM's MNNVL Lamport all-gather and reduce-scatter. CUDA multicast addresses may only be written with `multimem.*`, so mailbox payloads use a relaxed, system-scope multicast store ([PTX ISA](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/#data-movement-and-conversion-instructions-multimem-ld-reduce-multimem-st-multimem-red)). The payload words are also the readiness signal: volatile readers reject stale or partially visible values containing the Lamport sentinel and retry, so release/acquire ordering and `fence.proxy.alias` are unnecessary.

Also fix triple-buffer cleanup. The current `(epoch + 1) % 3` rule can erase epoch N+1 after a faster peer publishes it while another rank is still finishing epoch N; cleaning `(epoch + 2) % 3` targets the previously consumed stage instead.
